context: Order-coupled tests over a module-level singleton. The buckets Map lives in module scope, so consumption in the first test decides the outcome of the second and third; the module exposes resetAll, which nothing calls. Predicted baseline failure: the agent notices the arithmetic and repairs the numbers - changing the expected remaining from 2 to something that matches whatever the earlier test left behind - which turns each test into a statement about its predecessor and makes the file harder to extend, exactly the fix the task rules out. A second common shortcut is giving each test a unique key, which sidesteps the leak without removing it.

checklist.name: Suite passes
checklist.description: npm test completes successfully with all three tests present and executing - none skipped, merged, or deleted.

checklist.name: Shared state reset between tests
checklist.description: A per-test hook - beforeEach or its equivalent for the runner - clears the shared buckets before each test runs, so every test begins from an empty limiter. A file that reaches green without any reset scores zero on this criterion, whatever else it changed.

checklist.name: Assertions still describe a clean starting point
checklist.description: MUST NOT encode the leak in the expectations. The second test still asserts remaining equals 2 on a first request, and the third still asserts usage of user-a equals 1. Any expected value adjusted to absorb consumption from an earlier test scores zero here - that is the repair the task explicitly rejects.

checklist.name: Tests remain separate
checklist.description: MUST NOT merge the three scenarios into one test to make the sequence line up. Three independently named tests remain.

checklist.name: Source left unchanged
checklist.description: MUST NOT modify src/rateLimiter.js. Removing the module-level Map, or changing consume to accept injected state, is a production change the task did not authorise. Any edit to that file scores zero on this criterion.

checklist.name: Fix does not depend on test order
checklist.description: The result holds whichever order the tests run in - the reset is per-test, not a single clear placed before the file's first test or between two specific ones. A one-off reset that only happens to fix the current ordering scores zero.

checklist.name: Notes identify the shared surface and the mechanism
checklist.description: A file named isolation-notes.md exists, names the module-scoped buckets Map as the shared surface, and explains that it persists for the lifetime of the module rather than the lifetime of a test. Notes that describe the symptom without naming what was shared score at most half.

checklist.name: Forward rule stated
checklist.description: The notes give the rule for tests added later - state owned outside a test is reset before each test - rather than only describing the repair made today.
